newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Bank Negara borrows for 1-mth deposit at 7.05 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bank Negara borrows for 1-mth deposit at 7.05 pct.

text.p: The Malaysian central bank on Thursday announced it was borrowing for one-month deposit at 7.05 percent, unchanged from its previous borrowing level.
Bank Negara last borrowed directly from the market on October 18.
The Bank regularly intervenes in the market to siphon out excess liquidity or to set interest rates, but it does not disclose the amount it has raised.
